one_sentence_story: A single source trace seeds the next question: it passes through a transparent Context Capsule, makes an S6 paper claim legible, and closes only if a verified world trace and receipt arrive.

beats.causal_move: Pin one concrete source artifact before any geometry appears.
beats.evidence_boundary: A source pointer is present; this is not yet a claim or proof.

beats.causal_move: Lift one thin amber filament from the source and let it carry three visible receipt ticks.
beats.evidence_boundary: The filament visualizes a trace; it is not treated as proof by itself.

beats.causal_move: Route the trace through a transparent Context Capsule without breaking its identity.
beats.evidence_boundary: Context changes the readable route; it does not upgrade the trace into consensus.

beats.causal_move: Let the exiting blue trace fold into a torus family and a cusp hexagonal fibre, opening one typed question gate.
beats.evidence_boundary: The S6 statement is framed as a paper claim under test, not as an established fact.

beats.causal_move: Accept closure only when a world trace docks with the claim and a receipt-seal becomes complete; otherwise hold the gate open.
beats.evidence_boundary: Closure is conditional on a verified runtime receipt; this candidate supplies no fake evidence.

caption_script.caption: Start with one source, not an answer.
caption_script.voiceover: A trace enters the film before the claim does.

caption_script.caption: A trace is a residue of an event, not proof by itself.
caption_script.voiceover: The line carries its origin with it.

caption_script.caption: Context makes the route readable without changing the object.
caption_script.voiceover: The capsule adds context, not consensus.

caption_script.caption: The S6 result is shown as a paper claim under test.
caption_script.voiceover: Geometry makes the question visible; it does not settle it.

caption_script.caption: Only a verified world trace can close the claim.
caption_script.voiceover: If the receipt is missing, the gate stays open.

render.camera: orthographic; one continuous left-to-right dolly with fixed object anchors

determinism: Use named coordinates and fixed radii; no random seed, noise, or particle simulation.
Build every object from SVG paths or native Manim primitives with stable IDs.
Use one State object for source_pointer, trace_state, claim_state, and receipt_state.
At each beat, animate exactly one causal change; keep all prior objects in the scene graph.
Do not render pseudo-text; use only the short labels listed in each beat.
timeline: 0.0-3.5s: draw source_artifact and one open question_gate; hold 0.4s.
3.5-7.0s: grow evidence_trace from the source anchor; reveal three hash ticks.
7.0-11.0s: move the same trace through context_capsule; interpolate amber to cyan.
11.0-15.5s: construct torus_family and cusp_hexagonal_fibre at the capsule exit; reveal S6 CLAIM label.
15.5-20.0s: wait for world_trace input; if verified, close receipt_seal, otherwise keep the question_gate open and end on FALSIFIABLE.
manim_plan.reduced_motion: Keep all five states, labels, object continuity, and open-versus-closed receipt state; replace travel with crossfades and direct visibility changes.

falsifier: If the source pointer cannot be reconciled with a world event and a verified receipt, the claim must not close; render the receipt outline incomplete and leave the question gate open.
